· Position vs SMA100/200 ($759.24/$730.04): mixed long-term trend, near SMA200.

[Momentum Indicators]

· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.9324→-2.0286): bearish expansion, continued decline after dead cross.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $728.44) + band width at 6.74%, indicating contraction.
[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing resistance ($749.53): near 20-day moving average and Bollinger middle band.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: sideways range, no clear trend formation.
[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis: accumulation phase, buy score 4. Consider buying upon RSI oversold exit and MACD improvement.
